affected_files.role: release job's Upload Release Asset step uses archived actions/upload-release-asset@v1 (verified)
match_reasons: verified: release job uses upload-release-asset@v1 with upload_url env

analysis.summary: The release job uploads the built ZIP via actions/upload-release-asset@v1, an archived/unmaintained action consuming the raw release upload_url. The modern replacement is softprops/action-gh-release (pinned to a release SHA) or the GitHub CLI's `gh release upload`, both of which take the tag rather than the upload_url.
analysis.details: Current implementation: ci.yml release job (needs: [build], if: release created) downloads the echofootprint-chrome artifact, then runs actions/upload-release-asset@v1 with upload_url: github.event.release.upload_url and asset_name echofootprint-<tag>.zip. Limitation: the action is archived (last meaningful update years old) and unversioned-pinned at v1; it also fails silently-ish on retried releases. Change surface: one step in one file. Replacement options keep identical asset naming; softprops/action-gh-release is the de-facto standard and can also create the release. Verification per the issue: `grep upload-release-asset .github/workflows/ci.yml` exits 1. Closes F-CI-003.
